title: Text and writing rules
slide_intent: Show how to set dates and times at different lengths while keeping practical information easy to scan.
strategic_value: Consistent date expansion and contraction can make schedules readable across poster formats without changing the tone of the listing.
demonstration: Two Graves Gallery posters retain the sculpture, green field and title. The event dates and opening days use full words on one poster and abbreviations on the other.
practical_value: When space requires shorter dates, use three-letter forms, retain the full year and use spaces around range dashes. Check the result beside the full version.

content_islands.name: Copy conventions
content_islands.spec: Place date, time, dash and email conventions in a narrow left column. Group examples under distinct labels.

content_islands.name: Poster comparison
content_islands.spec: Align two versions of the same Mark Firth poster at equal size. Keep image and hierarchy constant so the change in schedule text is visible.
